body.x: Beyerdynamic participated in ‘2018 CES SHOWSTOPPERS’ held in Las Vegas on 9th(U.S. time standard) and introduced Aventho wireless headset, which individual sound tuning is available.

Beyerdynamic Aventho wireless is a headset that allows you to enjoy music wirelessly through aptX HD Bluetooth transmission. This headphone can be controlled with an integrated touch controller located on the right. Beyerdynamic MIY application allows a user to customize the Bluetooth headset to the user’s hearing, allowing the user to experience the best music with unique, individualized sound tuning.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
